symptom: Go overlay generation depended on the caller working directory and failed when materialization was invoked outside the project checkout.
whyGateMissed: Overlay tests happened to run with the process working directory aligned to the host module, hiding that go mod edit and download commands had no explicit project directory.
earliestDetection: Change the test process to an unrelated directory before both module and archive overlay creation and require all Go commands to remain anchored to projectRoot.
